## Review checklist

Complete the items that apply:

- [ ] The change is focused and excludes unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the reported failure path.
- [ ] Original scans and imported source files remain immutable.
- [ ] Scanner behavior uses only plugin-reported capabilities and the existing JSON process boundary.
- [ ] Visible copy and durable documentation are updated in every affected localization.
- [ ] New code and resources have clear provenance and redistribution rights.
- [ ] No credentials, private scans, build products, or proprietary datasets are included.
